title: build-context-map .context/ artifact schema
description: Schema for context.md and map.md front-matter and structural rules. The validator (scripts/validate.py) enforces these rules in addition to checks that cannot be expressed in JSON Schema (citation resolution, path existence, orphan detection).

gitCommit.description: Git SHA (7-40 hex chars) or 'none' for repos without git

definitions_continued_._note: json-schema does not allow definitions to span keys; the two front-matter shapes are inlined below as named definitions.

scopeFrontMatter.description: Front-matter for any context.md describing a single scope (repo or subsystem).

structuralRules._note: Not enforced by JSON Schema; enforced by scripts/validate.py.
rules: Every context.md MUST have YAML front-matter delimited by '---' on the first line and a closing '---' before any other content.
Every map.md MUST use the mapFrontMatter shape; every other context.md MUST use the scopeFrontMatter shape.
Every section confidence comment '<!-- confidence: X -->' MUST appear on the line immediately after a heading.
Section confidence MUST be one of HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW.
Every HIGH-confidence claim MUST cite at least one `path:LINE` or `path:LINE-LINE` reference inside the same section.
Every cited `path:LINE` MUST resolve: the file MUST exist relative to the scope path, and the line/range MUST be within the file's line count.
Every file path mentioned in an artifact (in code-formatted spans) MUST exist relative to the scope, OR be marked as historical (e.g., '(removed in commit X)').
Every .context/$REPO/$SUBSYSTEM/context.md MUST be referenced by name in its parent .context/$REPO/context.md subsystem index.
Every .context/$REPO/context.md MUST be referenced by name in .context/map.md repo index.
There MUST be no .md files under .context/ (excluding .scratch/ and .handoff/) that are not reachable from map.md by following the index references.
The 'updated' date MUST be greater than or equal to the 'created' date.
The 'commit' field MUST match a real commit in the scope's repo, OR be 'none' when origin is 'none'.
